objective: Repair the contamination of the September-30 professional-work stage-1 task set without cherry-picking or reading replacement task content.

third_class_repair.why: TEXT_CONFIG is exhausted under the frozen rule. Current Brain main now has independently verified from-scratch Markdown-to-PDF generation with semantic readback, plus bounded native PDF editing; PDF is therefore a current Brain-owned artifact mechanism suitable for cheap stage-1 falsification.

replacement_pdf_selection_rule: Among the current public GDPval population, excluding the original four contaminated exclusions plus all three newly exposed September-30 stage-1 task IDs, restrict to tasks with <=3 reference files, 1-2 deliverable files, and at least one .pdf deliverable; choose the task with lexicographically smallest SHA256(task_id). Selection may inspect only task_id, sector, occupation, reference_files filenames/count, and deliverable_files filenames/count/extensions.
